text:
What could be so important about this
treasure that all the great powers are
searching for it?

Ｉ cannot say. Perhaps it is merely an
excuse for the Western powers to
justify their rule over the world.
Are you saying the Proof is a fake?

They can't just make up something
like that to suit themselves!

Yet if they invented it, the Proof
should be a treasure they could claim
at once.

The fact that no one's found it yet
may mean it really is proof of a true
conqueror.
Ah, yes.

That no one has found it yet may
suggest it truly is proof of a
conqueror.
Yes...

Either way, to stop the powers from
doing as they please, we must find the
Proof first.
Agreed.
This is... the cursed blade Muramasa...

Hmm... Such an eerie glow. Ｉt almost
seems to draw you in.

Yes! The same dull gleam as when it
left my hands.

And all this time, no one else found
it...

Well, FI! Today we're settling this
once and for all!
Kurushima! End this folly!

A samurai siding with foreigners! You
shame every warrior!

And is ravaging the mainland coast and
plundering defenseless people the
conduct of a proud samurai?

Oh, listen to you. So stiff and proper.
Just the sort Ｉ can't stand.

Heh heh, FI! Be my woman and
surrender. Your life alone will be
spared!

Sojin Kurushima... Keep running your
mouth, and Ｉ'll pluck out that
arrogant beard of yours.
Ha ha ha! ...Ｉ'll kill you!

Conqueror Escante, free the people of
the New World from your unjust rule.

Ha ha ha! What has Maldonado been
telling you? Ｉ certainly
miscalculated... To think Ｉ'd be facing
a woman like you instead of Valdes.

Valdes? You mean... the military
officer from your country?

Hmph... Ｉ've realized just how
softhearted Ｉ've been.

All that vast New World, and Ｉ've
been handing it to my homeland as a
source of revenue. Ah, what a waste!

So you bought weapons to win
independence from your homeland?

Exactly. You hate colonial rule, so
surely you can grasp the brilliance of
my plan.

The New World people shall have a
nation of their own. What a bold and
splendid vision!

How selfish. Only a villain would dress
greed up as justice.

You thought such nonsense would sway
me? You have badly misjudged me!

Hmph... Talking is clearly useless.
When a child won't listen, a spanking
is in order! All ships, charge!

Ｉt seems Ｉ arrived at just the right
moment.

He's my enemy too. Pardon the
intrusion, but Ｉ'm joining the fight.

Look there! That's FO! They're
the ones muscling in on our waters!
Yeah!

All hands, battle stations! Snake, take
command!
Aye.

Angel! Bring us around to their right
rear!
You got it! Leave it to me!
Dandy! Are the guns ready?
All preparations are complete.

Heh... what a thrill. Listen up, you
dogs!

Ｉt's time to settle who deserves to
rule these waters. Me, or FO!
Yeah!
Ｉ've never heard of this pirate.

A woman pirate is a rare sight. Ｉ
wonder what led her to it.

Whatever her reasons, we can't let
pirates run wild. Everyone, prepare for
battle!

Ｆound you at last! This time, we're
settling the score!
Yeah!

You never learn, do you? Back again,
FO? This time, you're going to
the bottom!
At last. Yuris, the ship thief.

What a cheap little nickname. Hardly
fitting for someone born to the highest
nobility.

So sensitive about a nickname. Ｉ
wouldn't have guessed. But once you're
sent to Batavia, you can say goodbye
to it.

Jacob Portunto, Ｉ presume. A
black-market trader playing pirate?
How impressive. Get too full of
yourself, and you'll regret it.

What? Ｉ don't have to take a lecture
from the likes of you!

You're Gabriel. Stop taking matters
into your own hands and violating the
agreement.

Taking matters into my own hands?
Agreements are made to be broken.
Watch that mouth of yours.

Ｉ could say the same to you. Or is
force the only language you
understand?

Now that sounds like fun. Come on,
then!

Kee hee hee! Who are you? Do you
want to die?
...Ｉs that even a person?

Ooh kee kee! Ｉ'll sink you! Sink you!
Sink you!

Hernan Berio, the Spanish pirate.
Commanding a fleet may have gone to
your head, but there's still someone
willing to face you.

Been a while since anyone dared face
me. These days, ships flee at first
sight. Being too strong has drawbacks.

Still, Ｉ've been bored long enough.
Ｉ'll give you a fight!

Ｉ'll never forgive Clifford! And
sending that vulgar brute after me?
He's the worst!

My, you're full of spirit. You look
nothing like you did a moment ago.
W-what?

Lil, thank her properly. Thank you so
much. You truly saved us...

Think nothing of it. They may still be
nearby, so stay alert.
Saved again... Ugh, how frustrating.
Lil!

Think nothing of it. They may still be
nearby, so stay alert.

Ｉ'll pay you back for this. Ｉ
promise!
Ugh... better withdraw. Retreat!
Damn it! Beaten by that vulgar brute!

Lil... This time, we're lucky to be
alive. Thank you so much. You saved
us...

Think nothing of it. They may still be
nearby, so stay alert.

Thanks for saving us... That was
close...

Think nothing of it. They may still be
nearby. Take care.

Ｉ can't keep relying on other people
to save me. Ｉt's embarrassing! Ｉ'll
get stronger. You'll see!
That's it, Lil!
Heh. Ｉ like your attitude.

Just what Ｉ'd expect from you,
Admiral FA! Maybe you didn't
need my help after all?

Not at all. You helped us. Thank you,
truly.
Heh, we're even now, right? Bye!
Perfect timing. Well done.

Thank me after Escante falls. We
withdraw for now, but stay alert.
Damn it! Let's pull back!
You okay?!
Ｉ seem to be... alive.
A tactical error on my part...
Not at all. Thank you for joining us.

Thank me after Escante falls. We leave
now, but stay alert.
We won.
Your command has improved.
Thanks to you, Xien.

Heh, nonsense. Ｉ've scarcely anything
left to teach you.

Lives lost to the sea... No, perhaps Ｉ
should say they've returned to the
mother sea...
Manuel...

Let us offer some comfort to the souls
of the fallen.

"The sea and a mother are so alike.
The ripples return, strangely familiar,
as though recalling the beat of a
mother's heart, now far away.

The sea and a mother are so alike. Ｉn
distant lands, they say, the two may
share their sound and written form.

The sea and a mother are so alike.
Both are part of a bond that never
fades as long as we live."
Manuel... Poetry?

Ｉ never would have guessed... Ｉ
thought ships were your only interest.

Not so, FI. Every man of the sea
carries a little poetry in his heart.

Ha ha! We won! A victory feast!
Yahoo!
One exception...

The sea accepts all things. May we
learn to do the same.

Damn, beaten again... But next time...
Huh?!
Bad news. No next time for you.
Heh heh...
What?! Say that again!
What, didn't you hear me?
No one here obeys you anymore!
Damn you! You traitors!

Something seems to be happening
aboard that ship.
Trouble is brewing. A quarrel, maybe.
Let's go. Bring us alongside, please.

We keep losing, and we're not making
any money. You're going to answer for
that.
My fault?

And why do you keep chasing FO
around?

Hah! You've got a reason you can't
tell the rest of us, don't you?

All you want is to get the Bloodstained
Shamshir back from FO. A
keepsake of your old man, isn't it?
That is... not why...

You've been slipping lately. Nobody's
fool enough to follow a boss who can't
make money. Get ready!
Her life is in danger.
But this is no affair for outsiders...
...Ｉ'll go.
Al!
What's this? Stay out of it, outsider!
...Don't get above yourselves, lackeys.

Ｉt's none of your business! ...While
we're at it, finish off both him and
Aziza!
Al, Ｉ will fight at your side.

Ｉ'm in too! Men who can only fight
when they outnumber someone are the
worst!
Yahoo! Come fight me!
...Pirates! Come on, then!

Why...? Why fight for me? We were
enemies only moments ago...

D-damn it, this looks bad! Why are
they going so far to help Aziza...?
Wait!
You came to save her too?

That's right. Lay a hand on her, and
Ｉ can't promise your safety.
FI FA...
...No way out, then.

Ｉf you'll release her without a fuss,
Ｉ'm willing to pay you something.

What if we demand 1,000,000? We hate
this woman that much.
...Don't be ridiculous!

Al, stand down. Aziza's safety comes
first.
All that money... for me...
Satisfied? Aziza, come over here.
We're done here. So long!

Betrayed by my own crew... How low
have Ｉ sunk? But why did you save
me?

Ｉ remember what happened in Basra.
You've intrigued me ever since.

Something has troubled me... Why
would one of your caliber stoop to
piracy?

You think too highly of me... Ｉ didn't
stoop to anything. Ｉ'm a pirate's
daughter. My father was a pirate.
Oh?

Those pirates were my father's men. As
a child, Ｉ learned swordsmanship and
the pirate trade by watching and
copying.
Your father...?

He died in an accident. ...That sword
was his treasure. Ｉt disappeared along
with him...
That is the Bloodstained Shamshir...

Ｉ wanted to be a great pirate like my
father. Ｉ copied everything he did...

So when Ｉ heard you had that sword,
Ｉ had to get it back. Ｉf Ｉ could...
Ｉf you could...?

Ｉ thought it would prove Ｉ was
getting closer to being like him... Heh.
But now...

Ｉ've realized that, more than
becoming a great pirate, Ｉ really just
wanted something to remember my
father by...

No wonder they abandoned me. Ｉ was
chasing something that wouldn't make
us any money. Ｉ can't blame them for
being angry.
Still drawn to piracy?

Ｉt wasn't piracy Ｉ was chasing. Ｉt
was my father. Ｉ'm leaving that life
behind.
Admiral...

Ｉ know, Al. That was what Ｉ had in
mind when Ｉ saved her. People of her
caliber are rare. Will you come with
us?

Thank you... Give me a place aboard
your ship, and Ｉ'll work as hard as Ｉ
can for you. You did save my life,
after all.
And from now on, just call me Aziza.

Very well. Ｉ'm looking forward to
seeing what you can do.

We're pulling back for today! Next
time, Ｉ'll settle this!
Empty boasts.

Tch. Ｉ'll withdraw for now, but Ｉ'll
never submit! Remember my name:
Aziza Nurennahar!
She just doesn't know when to give up.

How's that, Admiral? Don't look down
on me just because Ｉ'm a pirate!
...Yes. Ｉt seems Ｉ underestimated you.

Ｉf it took you this long to figure that
out, you're not much of an opponent!
FI! We must retreat!

We'll withdraw for now, but next time
won't be so easy for you!
Got away!
FI! We must retreat!

Ｉt was a mistake to take her lightly
just because she was a pirate...

Thought you could beat me? Next time,
prepare to die!

Time to face the consequences. You're
coming with me to Batavia.

Ow, ow, ow! Th-this wasn't supposed
to happen...
D-damn... My precious cargo...

Still worrying about your cargo? Such
devotion to your work... Or perhaps
it's just greed. Come along. We're
taking you to Calicut.
D-damn...

You sound as though you might be
entertaining, so Ｉ'll spare you the
gag. Ｆeel free to keep talking back all
the way to Havana.

Wh-why all this just for breaking the
agreement...? Ow, ow, ow!
Huh? Ah! Y-you?!
Have we met somewhere before?

Damn it! You've gotten in my way not
once, but twice!

Don't worry. Ｉ'm sure there won't be
a third time.

Eeeek! Damn you! Ｉ'll curse you!
Ｉ'll curse you! Ｉ'll curse you!

...Even a buzzing fly is quieter. Let's
hurry to Veracruz.
...N-now listen. Ｉ let you win!

Ｉ'm turning you over to the Athens
guild. Try anything, and Ｉ can't
promise you'll live.
Where's the enemy ship?
Vanished...
...We won?
Was that... truly a ghost ship?
Was that... truly a ghost ship?

Who can say...? Ｉ'm not usually
superstitious, but Ｉ don't think our
eyes were playing tricks on us.

Hmm. No clear answer. The mystery
remains.

Strange things do happen. The mystery
remains unsolved.

Ghost or not, our work here is
finished. Let's return to the Havana
guild.

There you are, FA, the Soaring Scarlet
Orca!

Today you die! Witness the might of
my iron-armored ships!
What is that fleet?!
Wh-what is that ship?!
Are those... ships clad in iron?!
Aaaaah!!
Lil! Are you all right?!
That Clifford! How dare he betray me!!
Ha ha ha! Give up already, girl!
Like hell Ｉ will!

Oh, no... We're completely surrounded.
We can't get away!
Damn it!
Help them.
Stay out of this.
Wait!
Who are you?!
That hardly matters. Hey, you there!
You mean me?

Grown men ganging up on a girl? Ｉ'm
not impressed.

Exactly. Despicable. A man should
always be kind to women.

What?! Shut up! This is none of your
business! Ｉf you don't know what's
going on, keep out of it!

Not everyone backs down when ordered,
especially with brutes harassing a
helpless girl.
Wait! Did you call me helpless?
Right now, you hardly look strong.
M-maybe, but Ｉ'm really...!

Lil, not now! Don't pick a fight with
someone offering to help us! Please,
save us!
Camille! You're deciding for me again!

Don't know what's going on, but this
damn dull rabbit hunt just turned up
some fine-looking prey. Think Ｉ'll
help myself!

Not everyone backs down just because
you tell them to!
FI!

Ｉf FI is on our side, we're in good
hands!

Tch. Don't know what's going on, but
this damn dull rabbit hunt just turned
up some fine-looking prey.
Ｉ'll help myself!
Aaagh! What's that supposed to mean?!
Here they come!

This isn't our affair. We're leaving the
battle area.
N-no...
Well, well.
Clifford?!

Richard did well for me, but it seems
he was outmatched.

Your part was to make the Ming
government abandon that foolish policy
of isolation. And you performed even
better than Ｉ'd expected.
...Ｉs that all you have to say?

Richard was right. Beautiful, but
headstrong. You meddled far too much.
A pity. You must die.
FA!!

Ｉ'm joining your side, whether you
like it or not! Ｉ hate leaving a debt
unpaid!
The Argot Company?!
Clifford! Prepare yourself!

...You're a troublesome one. Play with
fire, and you'll get burned.
Aah! What? An enemy attack?!
FO's fleet has opened fire!

FO! Wait... Kuhn was right after
all!

What?! That is not our fleet attacking
Lil! Who are they?

Kuhn has sent a fleet disguised as ours
to attack the Argot Company!

Kuhn's disguised fleet... So he's finally
shown his true colors. We have to help
Lil at once!

W-wait! Another fleet is approaching!
Those ships...
Seems we arrived in time...
Liiil!!

C-Camille! And Hodram...? What are
you doing here?

FI warned me: "Lil is in danger!"
Kuhn's disguised fleet is attacking you!
What?! Are you serious?!

This is what Kuhn is really like! We're
joining the fight too!

FI... Ｉ-Ｉ was such a fool... Ｉ'm
sorry...

Ｉt's all right. Ｉ'm glad we weren't
too late. Now, let's defeat Kuhn!
Let's go! All hands, battle stations!
Damn, it failed...!
Sir, this puts us at a disadvantage.
That is obvious! Damn it, withdraw!
Admiral! That appears to be the ship!

Admiral! There's a strange ship! Ｉt
might be the one!

Admiral! There's a strange ship over
there!

Admiral! There's a weird ship out
there!
Admiral! Odd ship sighted!

Admiraaal! There's a strange ship out
there!

Admiral! Ｉ have sighted an unusual
ship!
Ｉs... is that...?!

＜Jam＞
Admiral, we're back!

＜Yukihisa＞
The wako ships are destroyed. Our
mission is complete.

＜FI＞
Our losses?

Heh heh! We used that tactic of yours.
Losses? Not a scratch!

Our formation trapped the nimble wako
boarding ships. We sank them with
heavy fire and took no losses.
Hmm. Good work.
You both did well. Thank you.
Yahoo!
Yes!
Hey, Xien! We're back!
Ｉ hear it was quite a victory.

We followed FI's plan. Once we
took the windward position in that
narrow bay, victory was assured.

The enemy fleet showed up just like
Admiral FI said it would! Man, even
we were surprised!
A masterstroke. Brilliant.
Hmm. FI has done well.

She's terrifying, but... she's pretty
great, huh?
We owe our lives to her.

Still, Richard is insufferable. He's
useless aboard a ship, yet he acts like
he's FI's adviser.

What can you do? His powerful
connections back in England let us run
wild in Ming's closed waters.
Yet you have no such ties to Ｆrance.

Heh. Ｉ took the blame for a stranger's
crime, so Ｉ can't go home. When Ｉ
find him, he'll pay for it.
Yukihisa's fate is ironic too.

You stowed away on a wako ship to
seek a legendary sword in Ming, only
to end up hunting those same pirates.

Don't worry. Ｉ heard what my
countrymen were doing abroad. Ｉ
could hardly let it go.
Reassuring words.

＜FI＞
Ｉs Ｉan here?
You called?
Report on the coastal contracts.
Going well. Bribes work wonders.

We agreed to pay 3 percent of sales.
The officials will look away if we
disguise our ships as foreign vessels.
As expected. Utterly corrupt...

Harsh words, Admiral. The magistrate
knows he stands to gain more tax
revenue by looking the other way.

Merchants always seek profit. Winning
their support early was worth the
effort.

At any rate, the way is open. Trade
can begin immediately.

Yes. Make sure the ships are thoroughly
serviced in preparation for Kurushima's
retaliation.
Understood.

So you're the famous FA? You'd be
safer leaving before you get caught in
Kuhn and Pereira's feud.

Whoever wins, it won't do us any good.
What a pain... (Sigh.)
Why?

They came from far away to expand
their own countries. Whoever wins,
they'll just take advantage of us. The
locals won't gain a thing.

So neither side cares about the local
people...

Portugal and the Netherlands... Both
are looking to expand into East Asia.

Ｉt looks like we'll need to act before
any harm comes to my homeland.

Excuse me. Ｆorgive the sudden
interruption...
Who are you?

Ｉ'm Bergstrom of the Swedish Navy.
Are you Admiral FA, the one
everyone's been talking about lately?
...What if Ｉ am?

Ｉ just want to see for myself whether
you're our enemy.

Whether Ｉ'm your enemy... That's
entirely up to you.

Now let me ask you something. You
said you were with the Swedish navy.
Do you know the Argot Company in the
North Sea?
The Argot Company... Ｉ know of them.

Ｉ'm sorry to interrupt... What about
the Argot Company?
Who are you?

This is Camille. He's not part of our
fleet, but he's traveling with us for a
reason.

Ｉ know the Argot Company well...
Would you mind telling me what's
happened?
...Ｉt might be worth talking this over.

Kuhn and Pereira control Southeast
Asia. Ｉt seems FO and the Argot
Company have been caught up in their
feud.
So... it was true.

Wait... You knew about this? Who
exactly are you?

Camille's a young man with the Argot
Company. He's close to Admiral Argot.
They're just traveling separately for
now...

Understood. Does Admiral Argot know
that Kuhn is using her?

Ｉ don't think she knows yet... Damn...
So it really was true...

So you don't know the whole story
either. Kuhn set a trap.

He's driven FO
to the brink of a clash
with the Argot Company.

Admiral FA, Ｉ understand
the situation is complicated.
What are you planning to do?

Ｉ want to speak directly to the Argot
Company's leader, without an
intermediary. Camille... would you show
me the way?

Ｉ'm not sure Ｉ can... But Lil... Ｉ
think she's staying somewhere around
Batavia.

Batavia... Ｉ'll try there, then. Thank
you.

Camille... Don't you want to go
yourself? Ｉ think this would be a
good opportunity.

...Ｉ'm sorry. Ｉ just can't see her
right now...
...All right. As you wish.
Everyone ready to sail?

Oh, that must be Lil Argot, head of
Argot Company.
Seems so.
Excuse me. Admiral Lil Argot?

W-what's this about? Yes, Ｉ'm Lil.
Who are you?

Ｉ'm with FO. My name is FI.
Surely you've heard of me.
FI?! You came here in person?
Ah! You came to kill me?!

No. Ｉt seems Kuhn's really misled
you... Ｉ came to tell you the truth.
He's using you.

What do you mean? Kuhn's trying to
save the people of Southeast Asia. He's
a great merchant!

Ｉ'm only helping him! You're the one
running China's underworld, you
pirate!

You don't know what Kuhn's really
like... He plans to use you for all
you're worth, then get rid of you.

That's a lie! Stop making things up!
Do you have any proof that Kuhn's the
bad guy? You don't, do you?!

Don't you understand yet? Your life is
at stake. Ｉt's not too late.

You can't just spring that on me and
expect me to believe it! Hmph!
Stubborn girl...
We made it... That Kuhn...
Lil! Are you all right?!

Yes... Everyone, this was all my fault...
Ｉ don't know how to apologize...

Ｉt's over now. Kuhn's the one to
blame.

We seem to have escaped the worst.
Ｉ'll be heading back to the North Sea.
Ｉ'll take my leave, then...
Thank you, Hodram.
Thank FI, not me.
What will you do?

Ｉ'm going back to the North Sea too.
Ｉ've realized Ｉ'm nowhere near ready
to take on the world...
Lil... Ｉ'll go with you.
Thank you, Camille!

Leave the rest to us. We'll defeat
Kuhn.

We can't let a scoundrel like that get
away with this!
Well then... Sorry for all the trouble...

You must be FA, the one who's been
causing such a stir in the Ｉndian
Ocean lately.
And you?
With the Uddin Company.

Ｉ don't mean to offend, but we
Muslims have long run things in these
waters. We'd rather you didn't
interfere.

What do you mean? You want us to
pull out of the Ｉndian Ocean?

Don't jump to conclusions. We're busy
driving out the Europeans. We don't
have time to deal with you as well.
So...
Ｉ'd like to propose a joint front.

Stay out of our territory. Should
Europeans trouble you, we will offer
some support. What do you say?
...All right.
I can't agree to that.

Ha ha ha! That's more like it. Ｉ think
we'll make good partners. Until next
time.

Can't be helped, then. Our honor as
Arabs is at stake. We'll defend our
own waters.

H-how could Ｉ...?! Oh, my money! My
company! My fleet!

Oh, that's Nagarpur... What's he still
doing here?

He's no threat to us anymore. Without
money, he can't do a thing.
True...
Hah! All show and no substance!
Y-you! How dare you!!

The idea that money can solve
everything is just a fantasy of yours.
Haven't you learned that the hard
way?
Grr...!
FI is right. You need to calm down.

Aaaah, Ｉ don't want to be poor!
Somebody, money! Money! Give me
money!
Words are wasted on him.
Even this island has quite a town.

Ｉndeed. Ｉt will probably grow even
more as a hub for trade.
Meaning?

There are several towns along Africa's
east coast, including Sofala. But the
coastline is so straight that the trade
route is essentially a single line.

Yet Madagascar can serve as a hub,
letting goods follow several routes
between Cape Town and Mogadishu.

So if this island serves as a trading
port, East Africa won't have just one
trade route, and this town will grow
too.

This seems familiar... A large island
lies not far from Ming.

Ah... That island has no port for trade,
right?
Then we'll build one. Why not?

You do set difficult tasks... The
government won't stand by while you
build a town without permission.

What if profit is guaranteed? Those
bribe-loving officials will hardly
object.

A fine proposal! Let us return to
Hangzhou and set it in motion.

A second Madagascar there... The cost
will be great, but it should become a
major port!
FI, about that new town...

The initial plan is almost ready. The
rest depends on negotiations with the
government.
Admiral, leave those talks to me.
Very well. You are suited to such work.

Oh, you'll entrust it to me? Then Ｉ
have one more favor to ask...
Anything else?
Would you let me build the town?
Oh? You would lead it?

Hold on. Are you sure you can handle
a job like that?

Surely you can't remain in Ming
yourself just to devote all your time to
building a town...

You're right... Ｉ can't. There's still
so much Ｉ have to do...

Besides... Rumor has it the Ming
government is making some suspicious
moves in response to our activities.
What?!

Ｉ'll find out what's going on and
keep the government in check. Please
continue your voyages as usual,
Admiral.
Understood. This is in your hands.

Once negotiations end, construction
will need funds. Could you prepare
500,000 gold?
500,000. Yes, it will be ready.

Then Ｉ'll begin negotiations at once.
Please bring the funds to Hangzhou
when you have them.

Admiral FI! Ｉ've been waiting for
you!
Did the talks go smoothly?

Of course! Everything went smoothly.
Construction of Tamsui is already
underway, just as you envisioned,
Admiral FI.
Oh, so it worked.

Excellent. The 500,000 gold is ready
